name: Moriyama (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Moriyama city emblem in white: a stylised device of leaves and a loop, like a bird.
history: Municipal flag of Moriyama, a city in Shiga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 June 1965.

features.role: Moriyama city emblem — a stylised device of leaves and a loop, like a bird
